title: Material Blend 2-Mix Trio #08 (부채꼴 4구역·물결 / 동심원 4구역·물결 / 대각 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 2 different materials repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 41% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 1 o'clock, 4 o'clock, 7 o'clock and 10 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries the same material as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.
